Results.ReviewText: I replaced my old gas grill with this grill. This is my first time to buy a Weber grill. I've cooked twice and really like the performance. I really like the sear feature particularly when cooking steaks. During assembly it seems to be well constructed and should last years to come. The only reason I didn't give 5 stars is the lack of castor wheels. It's makes moving the grill a challenge particularly for senior folks. The design team for this grill is dummer than a box of rocks. Why in the heck would you not have wheels at all for corners? Okay Weber... I've read in other reviews this is an issue. Of course the reply is you'll forward this issue on to someone else. Well... now do something about it like offer a retro kit to add two castor wheels in place of the two support feet. Also... on the next generation model tell the design team to put wheels on all for corners. It's just common sense which there's not much of that anymore.
Results.Title: First Weber Gas Grill Purchase

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit® E-325 Gas Grill Stealth® Edition (Liquid Propane)

Results.ReviewText: This is our first Weber grill.  It is very well built and built to last.  It is the perfect size.  Highly recommend for everyone needing to replace their grill.

Results.ReviewText: Grill is well built, with a removable main lower pan making cleaning a breeze. Heat is even, and easily controlled with three control knobs. Lighting is easy through use of control knobs. Temperature gage is useful and very readable. Grates clean easily. Recommend using Mr Bar-B-Que scrubber (Walmart) as it leaves no steel bristles behind, and is easy on porcelain coated grates.

One is a set of wheels on the front to move it easily and the second is a built-in tank scale that shows the remaining fuel.  I would gladly paid more for the grill if these two items were included.

When I bought this new Spirit, I was so confused as to why I didn't see flame under the bars so called the customer service number.  The man on the other end was SO nice and politely explained the difference in performance Weber has improved upon over the past 2 decades.  I'm happy to say my grill is again showing me its a workhorse and why I will never buy any other brand...in another 20 years.
